contentList.content: In combat, grants githyanki the ability to <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_Fly">Fly</LSTag>.
When a githyanki casts <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_Fly_Spell">Fly</LSTag>, their melee weapon attacks deal an additional [1] until the end of the turn.
Affected entity has flown this turn. Its melee weapon attacks deal an additional [1] until the end of the turn.
